Londin. edit. insignitor auctam Annokationibus Honrici Stephani Locupletatus</TITLE>. <NOTE>Nova cura retensuit digessit &c.</NOTE> <AUTHOR>Ant. parsed.explanation: Fixed 8 mojibake/encoding errors (√§->ä, √º->ü/i, √∂->ö, √†->à, √ü->ß) to restore correct German characters (Buchläden, ausgeliefert, schön, künftige, Preis, währet, bis, à). Fixed 2 XML well-formedness errors: unescaped '&' in '&c.' and '& Gronovior' -> '&c.' and '& Gronovior' (bare '&' is illegal in XML). Added 1 missing structural tag: wrapped untagged responsibility statement 'Nova cura retensuit digessit &c.' in <NOTE> to avoid mixed untagged text inside <BIBL> and to make bibliographic structure explicit. Also normalized spacing in '7 fl. 30 xr.' for consistency.
